triage.note: Second finding from H1 (docs/evals/audits/2026-08-16-h1-heldout-triage.md), separate from the heading shape and surviving any fix to it. JNJ 2016 lost 18 of 21 items and still reported success_with_warning, because expected_item_missing is not in validate.AMBIGUOUS_CODES and therefore no VOLUME of it can escalate. The contract calls doc_status 'the frontend's headline banner' and invites consumers to threshold on it, so a document that lost most of its items must not present as a qualified success. Warning count and proportion carry information the escalation policy was discarding.

provenance: SELF-CREATED adversarial fixture: a copy of evals/fixtures/premier-pacific-2016/filing.htm with the first TWO occurrences -- the contents-page row AND the body heading -- of eight item labels deleted: 'ITEM 5.', 'ITEM 6.', 'ITEM 7.', 'ITEM 7A.', 'ITEM 8.', 'ITEM 9.', 'ITEM 9A(I).', 'ITEM 9B.'. 124 bytes removed (642,332 -> 642,208); only those literal label strings are deleted, no surrounding markup or prose is touched. BOTH occurrences are removed deliberately, and that is the whole design of this case: an earlier draft stripped only the body heading, which left the items listed in the contents page, fired toc_manifest_mismatch, and escalated to ambiguous ALREADY -- so it would have passed before and after the fix and proved nothing. With the contents-page rows gone too the manifest lists only the 12 surviving codes, no mismatch is raised, and the missing PROPORTION is the sole remaining signal, which is exactly the rule under test. MEASURED BEFORE THE FIX: 8 of 21 items missing (0.381), warnings are expected_item_missing x8 and nothing else, doc_status success_with_warning. THRESHOLD EVIDENCE, measured across all 17 non-refused dev fixtures: fifteen lose ZERO items; the only two that lose any are heading-unnumbered (1/23 = 0.043) and malformed-html (1/21 = 0.048), and both already escalate via toc_manifest_mismatch. Held-out JNJ sits at 0.857. The empty band is therefore 0.048 to 0.857. The floor is set at 0.25 rather than the band midpoint the repo usually takes (ADR-007/008 convention) because the cost asymmetry differs from a content-shape validator: a false 'ambiguous' is a conservative report a consumer can inspect, while a false 'success_with_warning' on a collapsed document is precisely the silent failure the battery exists to prevent. 0.25 still sits five times above the highest proportion any real filing in the set produces. warning_absent(toc_manifest_mismatch) is load-bearing, not decorative -- it is what keeps this case testing the new rule instead of the old one. Tagged invariant. NOT yet dual-passed by extraction-auditor. | T9 tranche 3 (ADR-016): `warning_present(expected_items_mostly_missing)` added. The case asserted `doc_status: ambiguous`, but three codes can reach that status and only one of them was pinned absent, so ADR-013's escalation rule — the whole reason this fixture exists — could have stopped firing with the case still green, `last_item_dominates` carrying the status instead. Added 2026-08-22 (gates-2026-08-22 T5-1, ADR-027): `confidence max 0.75` with no item key — an `ambiguous` document caps every item at BASE_WEAK, so no item in this envelope may outrank a weak-title item in a resolved one. Red at origin/main 4cb2128: every extracted item read 0.95 while doc_status read ambiguous. `envelope_shape` (SD-2/SD-6) pins the contract's mandatory fields on the `ambiguous` path.
